0022600123.text: The Bucks are 0-2 and 13th in the East, fifth in the Central and two games back, and they're looking for their first win of 2026-27 at home against an Indiana team that is 1-1 and third in the Central. Indiana will be without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring). Milwaukee won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 134-123 at home on March 15, 2026, and the two teams have not met yet in 2026-27.
